# ctyun_rocketmq_instances (Data Source)
-> 查询 RocketMQ 实例列表



## Example

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    ctyun = {
      source = "ctyun-it/ctyun"
    }
  }
}

provider "ctyun" {
  env = "prod"
}

# 查询所有 RocketMQ 实例
data "ctyun_rocketmq_instances" "test" {
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `region_id` (String) 资源池 ID

### Read-Only

- `instances` (Attributes List) 实例列表 (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instances))

- `state` (Number) 实例状态编码 1.运行中 2.已过期 3.已注销 4.已退订 5.扩容中 6.开通中 7.已取消 8.缩容中 9.重启中 10.网络变更中 11.运维恢复 12.运维停止 13.异常中 15.已欠费 -1.变更 101.开通失败
